_description:
L3 Market Sentiment & Quantitative Risk Scoring Rules — compiled from 三层多因子投研框架 v1.4 + 评分可解释性手册 v1.1. PRIMARY scoring reference for L3. Two sub-modules: Sentiment (50%) + Risk (50%).

  NOISE REMOVED (2026-06-12): Removed AAII Survey factor. Rationale: retail sentiment poll — behavioral psychology data, neither fundamental economic data nor market-derived quantitative measure. Remaining 4 sentiment factors renormalized to 0.25 each.
_source_sops: sop/评分可解释性手册.md (v1.1 §三/四)

sentiment.description: 市场情绪温度：VIX + Put/Call + DXY + Credit Spread。AAII仅保留观察，不纳入评分。

factors.name: vix
factors.label: VIX 恐慌指数
factors._qualitative_note: 评分统一映射风险偏好：1=恐慌/风险厌恶，5=亢奋/风险偏好。VIX=17约3，VIX<12约5，VIX=35为1。

sentiment.composite_formula: equal-weight average of observed factors; missing factors are omitted without neutral imputation; minimum observed weight 50%

interpretation.1.0-2.0: 极度恐慌/悲观 → 逆向买入机会
interpretation.3.0-4.0: 中性偏乐观 → 正常操作
interpretation.4.0-5.0: 极度乐观/亢奋 → 过热风险信号

sentiment._removed_20260612: aaii_survey factor removed — retail sentiment poll, behavioral not fundamental/quantitative

risk.description: 量化风险度量：VaR + CVaR + Max Drawdown + VaR Trend。基于60日滚动窗口。每只ETF独立计算后等权平均。

factors.name: var_95_1d
factors.label: VaR(95%,1d)
factors.description: 95%置信度下1日最大损失。绝对值越小越好。
factors.data_source: easy-tdx日线 → trade_date<=as_of_date → 滚动60日历史模拟

per_etf_scoring.method: 每只ETF的 abs(VaR) 打分后等权平均

factors.name: cvar_95_1d
factors.label: CVaR(95%,1d)
factors.description: 95%置信度下尾部条件期望损失。比VaR更保守。
factors.data_source: easy-tdx日线 → trade_date<=as_of_date → 滚动60日历史模拟

factors.name: max_drawdown_60d
factors.label: 60日最大回撤
factors.description: 60日滚动窗口内峰值到谷值的最大跌幅。
factors.data_source: easy-tdx日线 → trade_date<=as_of_date → 滚动峰值计算

factors.name: var_trend
factors.label: VaR趋势
factors.description: VaR 20日均值 vs 40日均值变化。负值=改善(VaR在缩小)，正值=恶化。
factors.data_source: VaR时间序列 → 20d MA vs 40d MA

additional_metrics_computed.sharpe_ratio: (年化收益 - 无风险利率) / 年化波动率
